changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6b item 4: folded collaborators.ts's buildTeamMembers/buildTeamWorkflows/buildTeamScheduler into TeamService's constructor as direct new TeammateCollection(...)/new WorkflowService(...)/new SchedulerService(...) calls, each a pure one-for-one inlining of the forwarder it replaces. Removed the one real duplicate this fold exposed: the Team-fence wrap buildTeamScheduler put around submitScheduled (deps.admit(() => deps.submitScheduled(input))) reentered the same Team admission fence that submitToLeader (the thing submitScheduled is wired to) already opens with internally; a cron fire now reaches this.submitToLeader(...) directly, with the dispatcher-gate admission (SchedulerService's own opts.admit) as the only wrap ahead of it. The commands: {list, create, update, delete} wrapping is unchanged, since it composes that same dispatcher gate with the Team's own fence on top -- two different fences, not the duplicate the scheduled-fire path had. Renamed TeamCollectionOptions.dispatcherCompletionInitiator to leaderCompletionInitiator so it and TeamServiceDeps share one field name for one fact, which let TeamServiceDeps become Omit<TeamCollectionOptions, 'root' | 'nameSuffixGenerator'> plus the three per-Team-instance fields (teamRoot, store, settleWorktreeCleanup) instead of a hand-written field-by-field type, and let TeamCollection.depsBase() become a spread of its own options plus those three overrides instead of a field-by-field remap. TeamService now exposes startScheduler()/stopScheduler() as public verbs beside its workflow-admission verbs; TeamCollection's own startSchedulers()/stopSchedulers() call them directly instead of going through a private schedulers Map and a TeamSchedulerLifecycle handle, both of which are deleted along with TeamServiceCreateOutput -- TeamService.createNew()/rebuild() now return TeamService directly instead of {service, schedulerLifecycle}. No externally observable behavior changes: the double-fence removal drops a redundant reentry of the same admission check, not a check itself.
